identity.name: Passive OSINT Victim-Info Gathering — Subdomain / Cert / Email Harvesting (T1592 / T1589 / T1590)
identity.summary: An operator performs passive pre-intrusion reconnaissance: subdomain enumeration (DNS brute + cert-transparency), TLS-cert harvesting, and email/identity harvesting (theHarvester-style) against the org's external footprint. The signal is outbound OSINT egress plus the asset-inventory delta Cortex ASM/Xpanse produces as it independently discovers the same subdomains, certs, and identity exposures.
identity.description: Before active scanning (T1595) and before any exploit, adversaries gather victim information from open sources: enumerating subdomains and DNS records (Gather Victim Network Information, T1590), harvesting TLS certificates and host/software banners (Gather Victim Host Information, T1592), and collecting employee names and email addresses (Gather Victim Identity Information, T1589) to seed later phishing or credential-stuffing. This reconnaissance is largely passive — much of it never touches the victim's own infrastructure (it queries certificate-transparency logs, search engines, and breach corpora) — so the detectable footprint is twofold. First, the OSINT tooling run from a CortexSim jumpbox generates a recognisable outbound egress shape: a burst of DNS queries against the organisation's domain and many subdomain candidates (subdomain brute-forcing), and HTTPS sessions to certificate-transparency / OSINT aggregator endpoints (crt.sh, search APIs). Second — and this is the headline for the exposure-management story — Cortex ASM/Xpanse independently discovers the very same externally-observable assets (subdomains, valid certs, exposed mail/identity surfaces) from the outside, producing an asset-inventory and attack-path delta the DC reconciles against what the harvest found. The detection model: (1) an NGFW BIOC for the outbound subdomain-enumeration DNS burst (one source, many distinct labels under one parent domain in a short window) and an OSINT-aggregator egress XQL; (2) validation XQL confirming Cortex ASM/Xpanse enumerated the same subdomains/certs and any identity-exposure findings; (3) IOC signatures for the OSINT tooling fingerprints (theHarvester / amass user-agents, crt.sh access pattern). A correlation rule fuses the OSINT egress with the ASM discovery delta into a single 'organisation under reconnaissance' exposure-management incident — the earliest possible warning in the kill chain. SAFE-BY-DESIGN: this card only queries public OSINT sources and the org's own DNS; it touches no victim service and changes no state.

execution.framework_reference_id: T1592/T1589/T1590 — subdomain enumeration + cert-transparency harvesting + email/identity harvesting against the org external footprint

prerequisites.description: Target organisation domain set (defaults to the lab domain that fronts the infra/modules/aws/asm public assets).
Outbound DNS + HTTPS egress from the jumpbox is forwarded to XSIAM (panw_ngfw_traffic_raw / DNS logs) and Cortex ASM/Xpanse is monitoring the organisation's external footprint.

payload.code:
# step-1: subdomain enumeration via DNS brute-force (T1590.002) — many labels, one parent
for sub in www mail vpn dev staging api admin portal test git jenkins gitlab autodiscover; do
  host ${sub}.${TARGET_DOMAIN} 2>/dev/null | head -1
done
# step-2: certificate-transparency harvest (T1592 / T1596.003) — passive, public CT log
curl -sk -A "cortexsim-osint/1.0 (amass-like)" "https://crt.sh/?q=%25.${TARGET_DOMAIN}&output=json" | head -c 4000
# step-3: email / identity harvest (T1589) — theHarvester-style passive query (public sources only)
theHarvester -d ${TARGET_DOMAIN} -b crtsh,bing,duckduckgo -l 100 2>/dev/null | head -40 || echo '[CortexSim] theHarvester not installed — DNS+CT recon footprint already emitted'

input_variables.name: TARGET_DOMAIN
input_variables.description: Organisation domain to enumerate (lab domain fronting the asm exposed assets).

expected_artifacts.description: A burst of DNS resolutions for many distinct subdomain labels under one parent domain from a single source.

expected_artifacts.description: Outbound HTTPS to a certificate-transparency / OSINT aggregator (crt.sh) carrying an OSINT-tooling user-agent.
Cortex ASM/Xpanse independently enumerates the same subdomains/certs and any identity-exposure findings.

cleanup.code:
rm -f /tmp/theharvester-*.html /tmp/theharvester-*.xml 2>/dev/null || true
echo '[CortexSim] SIM-ASM-003 cleanup complete (passive recon — no state changed)'

iocs.context: Certificate-transparency log aggregator queried during passive subdomain/cert harvesting — OSINT reconnaissance egress signature when paired with a tooling user-agent.
OSINT subdomain/cert harvesting tooling user-agent (amass-class) — passive victim-host-info gathering signature.

biocs.name: ASM EAL — Outbound Subdomain-Enumeration DNS Burst
biocs.description: A single source resolves an abnormally large number of distinct subdomain labels under one parent domain in a short window — the subdomain brute-force / DNS reconnaissance fingerprint (T1590.002) that precedes targeting.
biocs.logic:
dataset = panw_ngfw_traffic_raw
| filter app = "dns" or dst_port = 53
| filter dns_query != null and src_ip != null
| alter parent_domain = arrayindex(regextract(dns_query, "([a-z0-9-]+\.[a-z]{2,})$"), 0)
| bin _time span=5m
| comp count_distinct(dns_query) as distinct_subdomains by src_ip, parent_domain, _time
| filter distinct_subdomains >= 8
| fields _time, src_ip, parent_domain, distinct_subdomains

biocs.name: ASM EAL — Outbound OSINT Aggregator Egress With Tooling User-Agent
biocs.description: Outbound HTTPS to a certificate-transparency / OSINT aggregator (crt.sh and similar) carrying a recognised OSINT-tooling user-agent — passive victim-info gathering against the organisation's external footprint.
biocs.logic:
dataset = panw_ngfw_traffic_raw
| filter app in ("ssl", "web-browsing") and dst_port = 443
| filter dst_host contains_any ("crt.sh", "censys.io", "shodan.io", "hunter.io", "securitytrails.com")
| filter http_user_agent contains_any ("amass", "theHarvester", "cortexsim-osint", "subfinder")
| fields _time, src_ip, dst_host, http_user_agent, uri_path

xql_queries.name: ASM-003 Subdomain-Enumeration DNS Burst (1 src -> many labels, one parent)
xql_queries.query:
dataset = panw_ngfw_traffic_raw
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 1800)
| filter app = "dns" or dst_port = 53
| filter dns_query contains "${TARGET_DOMAIN}"
| comp count_distinct(dns_query) as distinct_subdomains, count() as queries by src_ip
| filter distinct_subdomains >= 8
| fields src_ip, distinct_subdomains, queries

xql_queries.name: ASM-003 OSINT Aggregator / Cert-Transparency Egress
xql_queries.query:
dataset = panw_ngfw_traffic_raw
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 1800)
| filter dst_host contains_any ("crt.sh", "censys.io", "shodan.io", "securitytrails.com")
| filter http_user_agent contains_any ("amass", "theHarvester", "cortexsim-osint", "subfinder") or uri_path contains "${TARGET_DOMAIN}"
| comp count() as osint_sessions by src_ip, dst_host
| fields src_ip, dst_host, osint_sessions

xql_queries.name: ASM-003 Xpanse Subdomain / Certificate / Identity Discovery Delta
xql_queries.query:
dataset = asm_findings
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 86400)
| filter finding_type in ("subdomain_discovered", "certificate_observed", "identity_exposure", "exposed_mailserver")
| filter asset_domain contains "${TARGET_DOMAIN}" or tags contains "CortexSimASMFinding"
| comp count() as discovered_assets by finding_type
| fields finding_type, discovered_assets

xql_queries.name: ASM-003 Identity-Exposure Roll-Up — Harvested Email / Breached Credential Surface
xql_queries.query:
dataset = asm_findings
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 86400)
| filter finding_type in ("identity_exposure", "leaked_credential", "exposed_mailserver")
| filter asset_domain contains "${TARGET_DOMAIN}"
| comp count() as identity_findings by finding_type, exposure_source, risk_score
| sort desc risk_score
| fields finding_type, exposure_source, risk_score, identity_findings

correlation_rules.name: Exposure Management — Organisation Under Open-Source Reconnaissance
correlation_rules.logic: XQL(ASM-003 Xpanse Subdomain / Certificate / Identity Discovery Delta) AND (BIOC(ASM EAL — Outbound Subdomain-Enumeration DNS Burst) OR BIOC(ASM EAL — Outbound OSINT Aggregator Egress With Tooling User-Agent)) — raises a single exposure-management reconnaissance incident when the OSINT harvesting egress co-occurs with Cortex ASM/Xpanse independently enumerating the same external footprint.

use_cases.name: Pre-Intrusion Reconnaissance Detection — Open-Source Victim-Info Gathering
use_cases.description: Validate that Cortex surfaces passive OSINT reconnaissance (subdomain enumeration, cert harvesting, identity harvesting) against the organisation and correlates it with the external footprint Cortex ASM/Xpanse independently discovers.

test_cases.objective: The OSINT harvesting egress fires its NGFW BIOCs and is confirmed in telemetry.
preconditions: Target organisation domain set; outbound DNS + HTTPS egress forwarded to XSIAM.
Cortex ASM/Xpanse monitoring the organisation's external footprint.
steps: Inspect Network Security Analytics for the DNS burst and OSINT-aggregator egress.
success_criteria: BIOC `ASM EAL — Outbound Subdomain-Enumeration DNS Burst` fires with distinct_subdomains >= 8.
XQL `ASM-003 OSINT Aggregator / Cert-Transparency Egress` returns >= 1 row.
IOC match on crt.sh egress with the OSINT-tooling user-agent.

test_cases.objective: The recon is correlated with the independently-discovered external footprint into one incident.
steps: Inspect Cortex ASM/Xpanse for the subdomain/cert/identity discovery delta.
success_criteria: XQL `ASM-003 Xpanse Subdomain / Certificate / Identity Discovery Delta` returns >= 1 row.
Correlation `CR-ASM-0003` raises a single 'organisation under reconnaissance' exposure-management incident.
Any harvested identity exposure surfaces in the identity-exposure roll-up for phishing readiness.

preventive_controls: Minimise external footprint: retire stale subdomains, scope wildcard certificates, and keep dev/staging/admin hosts off the public internet.
Reduce identity exposure: avoid publishing role-based email schemas, and monitor breach corpora for leaked employee credentials.
Treat net-new public certificates and subdomains as change events requiring review before they go live.
detection_engineering: Alert on outbound high-cardinality subdomain DNS bursts for one parent domain and on OSINT-aggregator egress carrying recon-tooling user-agents.
Continuously diff the Cortex ASM/Xpanse external footprint and alert on net-new subdomains, certificates, and identity exposures.
Stitch OSINT harvesting egress with the ASM discovery delta so pre-intrusion reconnaissance is one early-warning incident.
